es: Expresar una molestia con un mensaje en primera persona, pedir un cambio con Would you mind + -ing y disculparte sin retirar tu necesidad.

teaching.en: I feel tired when the music is loud after midnight, because I start work early.
teaching.es: Me siento cansado cuando la música está alta después de medianoche, porque empiezo a trabajar temprano.
teaching.explanationEs: Mensaje completo: I feel + emoción + when + hecho + because + necesidad.
segments: I feel tired when the music is loud
after midnight, because I start work early.
teaching.audioText: I feel tired when the music is loud after midnight, because I start work early.

teaching.en: Would you mind turning the music down after ten?
teaching.es: ¿Te importaría bajar la música después de las diez?
teaching.explanationEs: Would you mind + verbo en -ing: petición cortés de un cambio.
teaching.audioText: Would you mind turning the music down after ten?

teaching.en: I'm sorry I raised my voice, but I do need some quiet at night.
teaching.es: Siento haber alzado la voz, pero sí necesito algo de silencio por la noche.
teaching.explanationEs: Disculpa equilibrada: pides perdón por tu parte y mantienes tu necesidad con but.
segments: I'm sorry I raised my voice, but
I do need some quiet at night.
teaching.audioText: I'm sorry I raised my voice, but I do need some quiet at night.

teaching.en: I appreciate that you told me, and I wish I had asked first.
teaching.es: Agradezco que me lo dijeras y ojalá hubiera preguntado antes.
teaching.explanationEs: Wish + pasado perfecto: lamenta algo que ya ocurrió.
segments: I appreciate that you told me, and
I wish I had asked first.
teaching.audioText: I appreciate that you told me, and I wish I had asked first.

teaching.en: Next time, I'll ask before I borrow your things.
teaching.es: La próxima vez, preguntaré antes de tomar tus cosas prestadas.
teaching.explanationEs: Una promesa concreta con I'll convierte la disculpa en reparación.
teaching.audioText: Next time, I'll ask before I borrow your things.

teaching.en: Thanks for being honest. Let's agree on quiet hours after ten.
teaching.es: Gracias por ser sincero. Acordemos horas de silencio después de las diez.
teaching.explanationEs: Let's agree on + sustantivo: fija el acuerdo final.
segments: Thanks for being honest. Let's agree
teaching.audioText: Thanks for being honest. Let's agree on quiet hours after ten.

prompt.es: Escribe la conversación de ocho turnos entre compañeros de piso.

answer.text:
Sara: Tom, I feel tired when the music is loud after midnight, because I start work early. Would you mind turning it down after ten?
Tom: I'm sorry, Sara. I didn't realise. I wish I had asked you first.
Sara: Thanks for being honest. I'm sorry I raised my voice last week, but I do need some quiet at night.
Tom: I understand. I also feel frustrated when my things are missing, and I appreciate that you told me.
Sara: Would you mind asking me before you borrow my charger? I feel upset when I cannot find it.
Tom: Of course. Next time, I'll ask before I borrow anything.
Sara: Let's agree on quiet hours after ten, and I promise to ask you before I use your speaker.
Tom: Deal. From now on, we will check in every Sunday, and I will turn the speaker down before ten.
Sara: Perfect. Thank you for listening to me, Tom. I feel much better now.

Leo: Ana, I feel stressed when the kitchen is messy after dinner, because I need a clean space to cook. Would you mind washing the dishes before you go out?
Ana: I'm sorry, Leo. I wish I had done it earlier. If only I had more time in the evening!
Leo: I understand, and I'm sorry I raised my voice yesterday. I do appreciate your help at the weekend.
Ana: Thanks. I also feel tired when I come home late, so would you mind if we share the chores?
Leo: Not at all. Let's agree that I cook on Mondays and you wash up on Mondays too.
Ana: I promise to tell you if I am going to be late. From now on, we will speak honestly.
Leo: Deal. I'll be honest as well, and I'll ask before I borrow your things.
Ana: Great. Let's check in again next Sunday, and we can change the plan if it does not work.
Leo: Good idea. Thanks for listening to me, Ana.

feedback.es: Un buen diálogo combina queja en primera persona, petición cortés, disculpa equilibrada, wish o if only y un acuerdo final.
